hook: A whole AI chat OS in 24 kilobytes

beats.say: A developer wrote a bootable x86 operating system in pure assembly that runs the Qwen3 0.6B model, with no Linux, no C and no libc.
It cold boots to an interactive multi-turn chat in 74 to 94 milliseconds, with the model mapped straight from RAM on huge pages.
Under KVM on a sixteen core EPYC it decodes about 135 tokens per second, and it even runs live on a diskless Proxmox virtual machine.
